title: 2.5-million-year-old stone tools from Gona, Ethiopia
lineage: Research notes paraphrase the specified source passages; the notes are not a reproduction.

passages.note: Excavations 1992–1994, radioisotopic and magnetic polarity stratigraphy date Gona occurrences to 2.6–2.5 million years. Its global-priority claim predates subsequent finds.
